notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Phantom Steed.
easyPrerequisites: Salvager of Secrets is exiled by Phantom Steed.
description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Declare Phantom Steed as an attacker. It triggers, creating a token copy of Salvager of Secrets that's tapped and attacking.
When the Salvager of Secrets token enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn
